verses.text: People are actually saying that there is sexual sin among you, a kind that even people who do not know God would not allow. A man is living with his father's wife.
And you are proud! You should be full of sorrow instead. The man who did this should be put out of your group.
Even though I am not with you in body, I am with you in spirit. And as if I were there, I have already judged the man who did this.
When you meet together in the name of our Lord Jesus, I will be with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus will be there.
Then hand this man over to Satan, so that his sinful nature may be destroyed and his spirit saved on the day of the Lord.
Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little yeast spreads through the whole batch of dough?
Get rid of the old yeast, so that you can be a new batch of dough without yeast, as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed for us.
So let us keep the festival, not with the old yeast of hatred and evil, but with the bread without yeast, which is honesty and truth.
In my letter I wrote to you not to mix with people who commit sexual sin.
I did not mean the people of this world who commit sexual sin, or who are greedy, or who cheat, or who worship idols. To avoid them, you would have to leave this world.

What I meant is that you must not mix with anyone who calls themselves a believer but commits sexual sin, or is greedy, or worships idols, or speaks evil of others, or gets drunk, or cheats. Do not even eat with such a person.
It is not my job to judge people outside the church. But you should judge those inside it.
God will judge those outside. As the Scriptures say, "Remove the evil person from among you."
